pieces.name: main
pieces.notes: simple gable, 48 by 39 ft, ridge along the long NE-SW axis through about (461,583) to (656,444); both faces are parallelograms so both ends are gable ends; NW face darker, SE face lighter

pieces.name: front extension
pieces.notes: SE face continues about 5 ft further out along the SW half of the front, matches the step in the traced outline

notes: one gable with a shallow front extension; confidence high; dark blob on the SE face near (560,600) is a tree shadow, not a roof feature. Exclusions: tree crown overhanging the NW eave near the N corner
